title: Non-Adaptive 1-Bit Mean Estimation: Minimax Rates and the Sample-Interval Tradeoff
abstract: arXiv:2609.08564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study distributed one-dimensional mean estimation under a 1-bit communication constraint. Each agent observes one sample, drawn independently from an unknown distribution, and returns a single bit in response to a query $Q: \mathbb{R}\to\{0,1\}$ chosen by a central learner. The distribution has mean in $[-\lambda,\lambda]$ and $k$-th central moment at most $\sigma^k$, for a fixed $k>1$. The order-optimal two-stage protocol of Lau and Scarlett uses responses from the first batch to choose the second-batch queries, motivating the question of whether this single round of interaction is necessary. We answer this negatively: for every $k>1$, a non-adaptive protocol attains the adaptive 1-bit minimax rate (and concurrent works reached the same conclusion via different strategies). translated_title: 非自适应1比特均值估计：极小极大速率与样本-区间权衡
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在1比特通信约束下的分布式一维均值估计问题。每个智能体观测一个从未知分布中独立抽取的样本，并针对中央学习器选择的查询 Q: ℝ→{0,1} 返回单个比特作为响应。该分布的均值位于 [-λ,λ] 内，且k阶中心矩至多为 σ^k（k>1 为固定值）。Lau 和 Scarlett 提出的阶数最优两阶段协议利用第一批样本的响应来选择第二批的查询，这引出了一个自然的问题：这一轮交互是否必要。我们给出了否定的回答：对于每个 k>1，都存在非自适应协议能够达到自适应情形下的1比特极小极大速率（同期并行工作通过不同策略也得出了相同结论）。此外，当每个查询的取1集合 Q^{-1}(1) 被限制为至多 s 个区间的并集时，我们进一步确定了非自适应1比特估计器的极小极大样本复杂度……
tldr: 该论文证明对于所有 k>1，非自适应的1比特协议即可达到自适应协议的极小极大速率，表明分布式均值估计中交互式学习并非必要，并刻画了查询区间数受限情形下的样本复杂度权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that for every k>1, non-adaptive 1-bit protocols achieve the adaptive minimax rate, showing that interaction is unnecessary in distributed mean estimation, and characterizes the sample-interval tradeoff under query interval constraints.
